conditions.initialization: Each model retains its own body/suspension/wheel-speed trim; physical vy/r are perturbed and tire internal relaxation restarts at zero.

rate_convention: Body-fixed p/q angular rates in deg/s, not Euler roll/pitch-angle derivatives. A nonzero body pitch rate can coexist with steady Euler pitch during turning.
startup_note: All original elapsed samples are retained. First logged values may already be slightly evolved from requested physical initial states. No startup rows are removed or timestamps shifted.
scope: General source-based model corrections re-evaluated on all three available trajectories, not a blind holdout or proof of 210-condition/full-stability-region equivalence. Only selected computed outputs and hashes are published.
